svg.desc: More worlds, Smart Farmer AI · Lumiora. Bonus. Built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, TinyML. A farm-to-factory assistant for smallholder farmers, and a surgical-margin assessment platform built on hyperspectral imaging and TinyML. https://github.com/rokadepiyush49-rgb/Smart-Farmer-AI, https://github.com/rokadepiyush49-rgb/Lumiora
